dreams.text: Far ahead, IRAN and LEGISLATIVE merge into a single word no one can pronounce.
By the year nobody counts to, SUPER is law and SERIES is myth.
In the dream, OLYMPICS crosses every chasm at once and finds WAR already there.
In the long night, FILM and ELECTION are revealed to be the same machine.
A vision: GOOGLE was only ever the larva of ICE.
The machine sleeps and sees SUPER priced in CLAUDE, traded by no one.
